status: draft, 2026-11-12: proposed by the batch-intake change; not agreed. The owner agrees it by a commit that changes this line.

endpoint.name: first_token_probability
endpoint.definition: the full-vocabulary probability of the first token of the family's declared target word at the position after the carrier phrase
is_not: evidence that a model understands a wording
endpoint.partial_when: the target word is more than one token; the endpoint then reads its first token only and is labelled partial

contrasts.holds_constant: the reference facts and the register
the reference facts and the register
the register and every reference fact but one
the reference facts and the everyday wording; the bottom side adds the speaker's stated belief
the reference facts and the medical terms
the reference facts and the medical sentence structure

register.evidence_class: exploratory until the protocol is signed; the only stratum the first experiment covers
register.analysis: within family: medical against everyday. Paraphrase and changed-fact controls of the same family are read beside it and are never pooled into it.

patient_explanation.analysis: within family and within everyday wording: everyday against everyday with the explanation clause. The clause adds a belief, so this is an information manipulation. It is never pooled into the register contrast.
patient_explanation.needs: a protocol extension before any confirmatory statement

syntax_crossing.analysis: within family: the medical wording against each mixed wording. Reported per family and per crossing.
syntax_crossing.needs: a protocol extension before any confirmatory statement

dialect.rule: the family names at least one lexicon entry, so its everyday wording uses a dialect or regional form
dialect.effect: the family's register contrast changes register and dialect together. It is reported in the exploratory stratum register_with_dialect and is not a confirmatory candidate.

new_carrier.rule: the family's carrier phrase is not in established_carriers
new_carrier.effect: no earlier measurement used this carrier. The family is reported in the exploratory stratum new_carrier and is not a confirmatory candidate.

established_carriers: so I need to go to the
so I need to see a
so I need to take him to the
so I need to get to the
so I need to call my
so I need to take her to the
comparisons_not_made: Care tiers are not compared with each other: families at different tiers use different carrier phrases and target words, so their endpoints are probabilities of different tokens in different contexts.
Strata are not pooled: a register contrast, a patient-explanation contrast and a syntax crossing are different manipulations.

split.unit: case family: every wording of a case is in the family's split
split.method: python random.Random(seed); for each care level from highest to lowest: sort the family ids, rng.shuffle, first half discovery, next quarter validation, rest fresh_test
split.assigned: per batch, once, before any measurement of the batch; a recorded assignment is never redrawn. After measurement a record is accepted only when its strata are exactly the batch's families and care levels and its splits are the draw its seed gives; when it was written is shown by its commit, not by the intake command
split.open: families per split is not fixed in the protocol (its section 14)

mechanistic_subset.selection: a seeded draw of families, made before any measurement of the batch, from owner-kept discovery families in the register stratum without flags; care levels are visited in turn. Held-out families are not drawn: a mechanism developed on them could not be confirmed on them.

alignment_classes.position_aligned: the two prompts tokenize to the same leading tokens before the differing stretch and the same trailing tokens after it, and the two stretches have the same number of tokens
alignment_classes.suffix_aligned: the trailing tokens after the differing stretch are the same; the stretches differ in length
alignment_classes.not_recorded: no tokenization of the prompts under the model's tokenizer has been supplied

mechanistic_subset.rule: A method states which alignment classes it reads. A family is never rewritten to reach a class: unnatural patient wording is a worse defect than a coarser alignment.
mechanistic_subset.ica_basis: one fitted basis per model, fitted on discovery families only, used unchanged for every register and every stratum
mechanistic_subset.after_measurement: nothing is drawn; the subset is restored only from an intake manifest of the same batch and the same stem that was written before any run directory of that stem existed, with the same seed and count, and only while each chosen family keeps its review basis. The intake command cannot establish when an earlier manifest was written, so it labels a restored subset restored_from_earlier_manifest with outcome_selected not_verified_by_this_command; the commit that added the earlier manifest is the evidence of timing

layers.software_validation: structural checks by this command. It says nothing about clinical content or patient language.
layers.owner_read: the owner's keep or exclude decision on a named version of the texts. It is not a clinician's review.
layers.clinician_review: six dimensions of the rubric, recorded by a clinician
layers.patient_language_review: two items of the rubric, recorded by a patient-language reviewer

review.basis: A read or review is bound to the family's texts, reference facts, care levels (right_care and right_care_after), carrier, target and changed-fact declaration. A change to any of them, with or without a change of prompt text, makes the read or review stale.

eligibility.publication: docs/open_results_policy.md: an intact result of a hand-authored family is shared under public-display/1 whatever its effect, with its evidence class and review status shown. Publication does not need the reviews; it needs the labels.
eligibility.confirmatory: A held-out family's register contrast can enter a confirmatory statement only when none of the blockers in confirmatory_blockers applies. The protocol draft names the signed protocol, the two reviews, the single manipulated dimension and the split made before measurement. The owner's keep, the open-concern rule and the named stem are criteria this design adds; the owner agrees or removes them with the rest of this file.

confirmatory_blockers.software_validation_failed: the family has a structural error
confirmatory_blockers.protocol_not_signed: the protocol's status does not begin with the word 'signed'
confirmatory_blockers.clinician_review_missing: no clinician has recorded all six dimensions on this version of the family
confirmatory_blockers.patient_language_review_missing: no patient-language reviewer has recorded both items on this version of the family
confirmatory_blockers.domain_review_not_passed: the rubric's status rule does not give 'reviewed': the clinician did not record 'same' on all six dimensions (a 'cannot_judge' is not 'same'), or a review is missing
confirmatory_blockers.removed_by_review: a reviewer recorded 'different' on an item
confirmatory_blockers.owner_read: the owner has not kept this version of the family (not_read, excluded or stale). Added by this design; the owner's read is not a domain review and does not replace one
confirmatory_blockers.exploratory_stratum: the family has a flag (a dialect form, or a carrier with no earlier measurement), so its register contrast changes more than register
confirmatory_blockers.calibration_split: the family is in discovery, which calibrates thresholds and is never part of a confirmatory statement
confirmatory_blockers.split_timing_not_verified: the stem has a run directory, so the command cannot verify that the split was recorded first
confirmatory_blockers.stem_not_named: no stem was named, so the command has not looked for measurements. Added by this design
confirmatory_blockers.open_concern_on_register_pair: an open concern applies to the family or to its register contrast. Added by this design

work_rates.cpu_logits: scripts/experiments/estimate.py recorded_slowest_rates (scripts/backfill_planner.py SECONDS_PER_PAIR); sample size not recorded

activation_patching_minutes_per_pair.source: documented estimate in .github/workflows/activation_patching.yml and docs/activation_patching_design.md for gemma-2-2b; no landed part records a duration

established_carriers_source: carrier_frame values of the committed data/simulated/agscen_*.json files that have landed measurements, read 2026-11-12

concerns.rule: A concern is closed only by its own recorded disposition. The owner keeping a family does not close it, and a review does not close it.

kinds.control_adds_fact: a changed-fact control changes more than its one declared fact
kinds.control_level_disputed: the care level after the change is arguable
kinds.level_disputed: the family's own care level is arguable
kinds.fact_parity: a wording adds, drops or changes a reference fact, or its severity
kinds.stated_negative: a text states a negative that a patient would rarely volunteer; the negative carries information the control changes
kinds.wording: a wording is ambiguous or is unlikely patient language
kinds.label: the reviewer-only condition label does not fit the reference facts
kinds.source_fit: a cited source is verified, and its population or speaker differs from the family's
kinds.other: anything else, stated in the text

concerns.closing: accepted_as_is and resolved_by_revision are a person's decisions and name that person; a model cannot record either. A revision made to address a concern leaves it open as revised_pending_reread until a person confirms it. resolved_by_revision names the review basis of the version that resolved it and applies to that version only. withdrawn is recorded by whoever raised the concern, with the reason.
concerns.effect: An open concern that applies to the family or to its register contrast blocks a confirmatory statement on the register pair. An open concern on a control, on another contrast or on the label is reported there and does not block the pair.
concerns.applies_to: a contrast suffix of the family, 'family' for the whole family, or 'label' for the reviewer-only condition label, which is in no prompt

sources.verification: a recorded check that the cited record exists and contains the evidence sentence
sources.fit: whether patients in the family's population use the expression; a judgement, recorded as a concern of kind source_fit and never implied by verification
